experience.description: Executed complex sensor interpolations, applied SMOTE for class imbalances, engineered features, trained XGBoost classifiers, and implemented SHAP values for model interpretability.

artificial_intelligence.name: FactoryGuard AI (IoT Predictive Maintenance)
artificial_intelligence.description: A machine learning solution to predict equipment failure before it occurs using high-fidelity sensor data from jet engines (NASA CMAPSS). Features an XGBoost engine and Flask API.

artificial_intelligence.name: Lung Cancer Detection using CNN
artificial_intelligence.description: A deep learning-based approach using Inception V3 Transfer Learning for early and accurate detection of lung cancer using medical imaging data (CT scans/X-rays).

artificial_intelligence.name: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) Prediction using Machine Learning
artificial_intelligence.description: A behavioral and demographic data-driven machine learning approach to predicting traits associated with Autism Spectrum Disorder. Focuses on SHAP interpretability for behavioral trait analysis.

artificial_intelligence.name: Epileptic-Seizure-Recognition
artificial_intelligence.description: Implemented a machine learning approach (Support Vector Classifier) to classify drugs based on biomarkers related to epileptic seizures. Features SHAP Permutation Explainers.

automation.name: Lili AI (Personal Care LLM POC Chatbot)
automation.description: Named after his mother, this is a domain expert chatbot in the personal care and grooming sector. Powered by a Large Language Model (Llama-3.3-70b via Groq API) with strict operational guardrails and PostgreSQL audit logging.

web_scraping.name: TrendScout E-Commerce Intelligence Collector
web_scraping.description: An automated data extraction tool using Selenium to gather real-time competitive intelligence from major e-commerce platforms like Myntra, bypassing anti-bot measures.

data_science.name: Predictive Modeling for Customer Tipping Behavior in NYC Taxis
data_science.description: Analyzes the NYC TLC dataset to predict customer tipping behavior using 50,000+ records and Random Forest/XGBoost classification models.

data_science.name: Employee Attrition Prediction for HR-Analytics
data_science.description: An AI-powered employee attrition prediction system using Random Forest algorithms to analyze HR capstone data and predict turnover risk.

data_science.name: The Conversion Catalyst: A/B Testing Strategy
data_science.description: Simulates a real-world product experiment for an e-commerce platform using Z-tests and Chi-Square analysis to optimize checkout strategies.

publications_and_research.title: Machine Learning Approaches in Drug Classification from biomarkers of Epileptic Seizure
publications_and_research.details: Co-authored paper presenting original research on drug classification utilizing supervised learning models to categorize pharmaceuticals.

publications_and_research.title: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) Prediction using Machine Learning
publications_and_research.details: Research utilizing AQ-10 screening data and ensemble classifiers to predict ASD traits with strong emphasis on feature interpretability.
